Verifier notes and special checks

A cautionary bass clef on the lower staff at the end of P052 takes effect at P053. System 8 has seven complete bars between ordinary barlines. P052 closes with a double bar and that cautionary bass clef. P053 begins with three naturals on both staves, cancelling the three sharps, and its lower-staff notes are in bass.
